method: Project the unobserved September account count from August's 40.090 million plus the mean of the July and August net additions (138,000 and 150,000), giving a normal latent count with mean 40.234 million and a subjective 75,000 standard deviation for missing-month and revision uncertainty, not a fitted confidence interval. For reporting precision uncertainty, equally weight rounding to the nearest 1,000 and nearest 100,000 accounts, and calculate strict-above chances using each strike plus half its rounding step. October 15, 2026 is an expected report date inferred from the announced Fall Business Update, not a verified earnings-release announcement; the latest checked public measurement is August, with refreshed issuer pages blocked and no newer measurement in the checked searches.
